## Evidence checklist

- [ ] Each medical claim uses `[^source-id|locator]`, and the locator is a section, page, table, or figure.
- [ ] Every source has an id, title, authors or organization, year, tier, and a URL or DOI.
- [ ] No claim is supported only by a tier 3 source.
- [ ] Unsupported sentences were deleted, not softened.
- [ ] Thin evidence uses `:::evidence-limited`, with a citation inside.
- [ ] The page does not give a dose, dosing interval, or course length.
- [ ] `last_verified` is the date the claims were checked against the cited passages.
- [ ] `status` is not `vet-reviewed` unless `reviewed_by` is a person in `REVIEWERS.md` and they reviewed this version.
- [ ] The same claims exist in zh-TW, en, zh-CN, and ja, with the same source ids and locators.
- [ ] Text was not copied from Merck, WikiVet, or an NC/ND source.
- [ ] Every image has alt text and an entry in `docs/CREDITS.md`. SVGs are original local files, not traced figures.

## 檢查清單（繁體中文）

- [ ] 每項醫學陳述都有 `[^來源id|位置]`。
- [ ] 沒有只靠第 3 級來源的陳述，也沒有劑量。
- [ ] 來源沒說的句子已刪除。狀態不是獸醫已審，除非名單上的人審過這一版。
